```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 14))

# Read data
summary_df <- read.delim(params$summary_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
detail_df <- read.delim(params$detail_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
params_df <- read.delim(params$params_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Read coverage data if available
has_coverage <- nchar(params$coverage_file) > 0 && file.exists(params$coverage_file)
if (has_coverage) {
  coverage_df <- read.delim(params$coverage_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
```

## Run: `r params$run_name`

**Generated:** `r Sys.time()`

```{r run-params}
# Helper to look up a parameter value
get_param <- function(name) {
  vals <- params_df$value[params_df$parameter == name]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(vals, collapse = ", ")
}

# Build parameters table (curated subset of key parameters)
param_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Targets", "Distractors", "Probes", "Sample",
                "Capture method", "Host filtering",
                "Num fragments", "Fragment length (mean/min/max)",
                "Read length", "Distractor fraction",
                "Min match bases", "Max mismatches", "Seed"),
  Value = c(
    basename(get_param("targets")),
    paste(basename(params_df$value[params_df$parameter == "distractors"]), collapse = ", "),
    basename(get_param("probes")),
    ifelse(get_param("sample") == "none", "all targets", basename(get_param("sample"))),
    get_param("capture_method"),
    ifelse(get_param("host_fasta") == "none", "none", basename(get_param("host_fasta"))),
    get_param("num_fragments"),
    sprintf("%s / %s / %s", get_param("fragment_length_mean"),
            get_param("fragment_length_min"), get_param("fragment_length_max")),
    get_param("read_length"),
    get_param("distractor_fraction"),
    get_param("min_match_bases"),
    get_param("max_mismatches"),
    ifelse(get_param("seed") == "none", "random", get_param("seed"))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(param_table, align = "ll")
```

<details><summary>Command</summary>

```{r command, results='asis'}
# Reconstruct the baitbench command from run_params.tsv.
# This is fully data-driven: new parameters added to run_params.tsv
# appear here automatically without any template changes.
cmd_parts <- c("baitbench run")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(params_df))) {
  flag <- params_df$flag[i]
  value <- params_df$value[i]
  # Skip parameters that were not set (optional params use "none")
  if (value == "none") next
  cmd_parts <- c(cmd_parts, sprintf("  %s %s", flag, value))
}
cat("```bash\n")
cat(paste(cmd_parts, collapse = " \\\n"), "\n")
cat("```\n")
```

## Capture Summary

```{r capture-summary, fig.height=3}
capture_data <- data.frame(
  stage = factor(c("Generated", "Captured"), levels = c("Generated", "Captured")),
  fragments = c(summary_df$fragments_generated, summary_df$fragments_captured)
)

ggplot(capture_data, aes(x = stage, y = fragments, fill = stage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(fragments, big.mark = ",")), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Generated" = "#3498db", "Captured" = "#2ecc71")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of Fragments",
       subtitle = sprintf("Capture rate: %.1f%%", summary_df$capture_rate * 100)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  expand_limits(y = max(capture_data$fragments) * 1.15)
```

### Captured Fragments by Source

```{r capture-source, fig.height=3}
source_data <- data.frame(
  source = factor(c("Sample", "Non-sample Target", "Distractor"),
                  levels = c("Sample", "Non-sample Target", "Distractor")),
  fragments = c(summary_df$sample_captured,
            summary_df$nonsample_target_captured,
            summary_df$distractor_captured)
)

source_data <- source_data %>% filter(fragments > 0 | source == "Sample")

ggplot(source_data, aes(x = source, y = fragments, fill = source)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(fragments, big.mark = ",")), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Sample" = "#27ae60",
                                "Non-sample Target" = "#e67e22",
                                "Distractor" = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Captured Fragments",
       subtitle = sprintf("Total captured: %s", format(summary_df$fragments_captured, big.mark = ","))) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  expand_limits(y = max(source_data$fragments) * 1.15)
```

## Detection Performance

```{r metrics-barplot}
metrics_data <- data.frame(
  metric = factor(
    c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision", "F1 Score"),
    levels = c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision", "F1 Score")
  ),
  value = c(summary_df$sensitivity, summary_df$specificity,
            summary_df$precision, summary_df$f1_score)
)

metric_colors <- ifelse(metrics_data$value >= 0.9, "#27ae60",
                 ifelse(metrics_data$value >= 0.7, "#f39c12", "#e74c3c"))

ggplot(metrics_data, aes(x = metric, y = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = metric_colors) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", value * 100)), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.15), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Read Mapping Accuracy

```{r mapping-accuracy, fig.height=3}
mapping_data <- data.frame(
  result = factor(c("Correct", "Incorrect"), levels = c("Correct", "Incorrect")),
  reads = c(summary_df$reads_correctly_mapped, summary_df$reads_incorrectly_mapped)
)

total_mapped <- sum(mapping_data$reads)
accuracy_pct <- if (total_mapped > 0) summary_df$reads_correctly_mapped / total_mapped * 100 else 0

ggplot(mapping_data, aes(x = result, y = reads, fill = result)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(reads, big.mark = ",")), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Correct" = "#27ae60", "Incorrect" = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mapped Reads",
       subtitle = sprintf("Mapping accuracy: %.1f%%", accuracy_pct)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  expand_limits(y = max(mapping_data$reads) * 1.15)
```

## Confusion Matrix

```{r confusion-matrix, fig.height=4.5}
cm_data <- data.frame(
  actual = factor(rep(c("Sample", "Non-sample Target", "Distractor"), each = 2),
                  levels = c("Sample", "Non-sample Target", "Distractor")),
  predicted = factor(rep(c("Detected", "Not Detected"), 3),
                     levels = c("Detected", "Not Detected")),
  count = c(summary_df$tp_count, summary_df$fn_count,
            summary_df$fp_target_count, summary_df$tn_target_count,
            summary_df$fp_distractor_count, summary_df$tn_distractor_count),
  label = c("TP", "FN", "FP_target", "TN_target", "FP_distractor", "TN_distractor")
)

ggplot(cm_data, aes(x = predicted, y = actual, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s\n%d", label, count)),
            size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#ecf0f1", high = "#3498db", guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Actual") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

if (nrow(detail_df) > 0) {
  detail_df %>%
    arrange(factor(classification,
                   levels = c("TP", "FP_target", "FP_distractor", "UNKNOWN", "FN")),
            desc(reads_assigned)) %>%
    mutate(
      ref_length = format(ref_length, big.mark = ","),
      avg_coverage = sprintf("%.1fX", avg_coverage),
      pct_covered_5x = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_covered_5x),
      pct_covered_20x = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_covered_20x)
    ) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      col.names = c("Reference ID", "Category", "Expected", "Detected",
                     "Fragments Generated", "Fragments Captured", "Reads Assigned",
                     "Classification", "Ref Length", "Avg Coverage",
                     "% \u22655X", "% \u226520X"),
      align = "llllrrrllrrr"
    )
} else {
  cat("No detection details available.")
}
```

```{r detection-lollipop, fig.height=max(3, nrow(detail_df) * 0.4)}
detected_only <- detail_df %>% filter(reads_assigned > 0)

if (nrow(detected_only) > 0) {
  class_colors <- c("TP" = "#27ae60", "FP_target" = "#e67e22",
                     "FP_distractor" = "#e74c3c", "UNKNOWN" = "#95a5a6")

  ggplot(detected_only,
         aes(x = reorder(reference_id, reads_assigned),
             y = reads_assigned, color = classification)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = reference_id, y = 0, yend = reads_assigned), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = class_colors) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Reads Assigned", color = "Classification",
         title = "Reads per Detected Reference") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

## Coverage {.tabset}

```{r coverage-overview, eval=has_coverage, fig.height=max(3, ceiling(length(unique(coverage_df$reference_id)) / 3) * 2.5), fig.width=10}
# Only plot detected references
detected_refs <- detail_df$reference_id[detail_df$detected == "true"]
plot_data <- coverage_df %>% filter(reference_id %in% detected_refs)

if (nrow(plot_data) > 0) {
  # Downsample if genome is large (>500 positions per facet) for rendering speed
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(reference_id) %>%
    mutate(
      bin = ceiling(row_number() / max(1, ceiling(n() / 500)))
    ) %>%
    group_by(reference_id, bin) %>%
    summarise(position = mean(position), depth = mean(depth), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = position, y = depth)) +
    geom_area(fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e67e22", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~reference_id, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    labs(x = "Position", y = "Depth",
         title = "Coverage Profiles",
         subtitle = "Dashed lines: 5X (orange), 20X (red)") +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 6))
}
```

```{r coverage-detail-plots, eval=has_coverage, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
if (has_coverage && nrow(coverage_df) > 0) {
  detected_refs <- detail_df %>%
    filter(detected == "true", ref_length > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_coverage))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(detected_refs))) {
    ref_id <- detected_refs$reference_id[i]
    ref_cov <- detected_refs$avg_coverage[i]
    ref_len <- detected_refs$ref_length[i]
    pct5 <- detected_refs$pct_covered_5x[i]
    pct20 <- detected_refs$pct_covered_20x[i]
    ref_data <- coverage_df %>% filter(reference_id == ref_id)

    if (nrow(ref_data) == 0) next

    cat(sprintf('\n\n<details><summary><strong>%s</strong> &mdash; %.1fX avg, %s bp, %.0f%% &ge;5X, %.0f%% &ge;20X</summary>\n\n',
                ref_id, ref_cov, format(ref_len, big.mark = ","), pct5, pct20))

    p <- ggplot(ref_data, aes(x = position, y = depth)) +
      geom_area(fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_line(color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e67e22", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 5, label = "5X", hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5,
               color = "#e67e22", size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 20, label = "20X", hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5,
               color = "#e74c3c", size = 3) +
      labs(x = "Genome Position", y = "Coverage Depth",
           title = sprintf("Coverage: %s", ref_id),
           subtitle = sprintf("%.1fX avg | %.0f%% \u22655X | %.0f%% \u226520X | %s bp",
                              ref_cov, pct5, pct20, format(ref_len, big.mark = ","))) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

    print(p)
    cat('\n\n</details>\n\n')
  }
}
```
